prompt: Why is the booth speaker turned off?
promptZh: 錄音亭的喇叭為什麼關著？

options.text: To prevent other visitors from hearing the story’s location.
options.zh: 不讓其他人聽見故事發生地點。
options.whyZh: 地點寫在卡上，關喇叭的理由是避免同時播放。

options.text: To make sure visitors bring their own headphones.
options.zh: 為了確保訪客自備耳機。
options.whyZh: 原文請訪客用耳機試聽，沒有要求自備。

options.text: To prevent the microphone from moving.
options.whyZh: 志工會按收音需要移麥；這和關喇叭無關。

options.text: To avoid playing audio over someone else’s recording.
options.zh: 避免播放聲音干擾別人錄音。
options.whyZh: 講者明說喇叭不開，以免另一個人正在錄音時播放聲音。

explanationZh: 講者明說喇叭不開，以免另一個人正在錄音時播放聲音。
evidence: The booth speaker is off so it won’t play while someone else is recording.

evidenceSpans.speaker: N
